# objc

```text
usage: objc [-h] {show-class,list-classes} ...

```

Objective-C Support

This command is composed of a number of subcommands providing support for
inspecting and interacting with the Objective-C ABI in Darwin-based systems.
### Positional arguments

|Positional Argument|Help|
| :--- | :--- |
|command||

### Optional arguments

|Short|Long|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
|-h|--help|show this help message and exit|

### **objc show-class**

```text
usage: objc show-class [-h] [-m MODULE] (-a ADDRESS | -n NAME)

```

Show information about a given Objective-C class

The information is presented in a pseudo-Objective-C syntax, that displays
the value string for properties and the addresses of IMP pointers and selectors
for methods, but omits type information.

It is given in the form:
```
@implementation <ClassName> : <SuperName>

@property <PropertyName> = <PropertyValue>

- <ClassMethodSelector> (<SelectorAddress>) @ <IMP>

+ <InstanceMethodSelector> (<SelectorAddress>) @ <IMP>

@end
```
#### Optional arguments

|Short|Long|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
|-h|--help|show this help message and exit|
|-m|--module|Name of the module from which the class is going to be looked up. By default this is the main module.|
|-a|--address|Address at which the class metadata starts|
|-n|--name|Name of the class to display|

### **objc list-classes**

```text
usage: objc list-classes [-h] [-f] [-A | -m MODULE | -a]

```

Lists Objective-C classes present in the process
#### Optional arguments

|Short|Long|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
|-h|--help|show this help message and exit|
|-f|--full|Display full information for each class in the manner of objc-show-class, rather than just their names.|
|-A|--all-with-shared-cache|List classes from all modules in the process, including those in the shared cache.|
|-m|--module|Name of the module from which the classes are going to be listed. By default this is the main module.|
|-a|--all|List classes from all modules in the process, except those in the shared cache.|
